# MiniMax H3 Cases & Guides

> A bilingual, source-attributed library of MiniMax H3 video examples. Videos are playable through their original source, and prompts appear only when creators or official scripts publish the complete text.

## Library snapshot

- 745 published MiniMax H3 video examples
- 3 official reproducible examples
- 742 source-attributed X community examples
- 72 examples with verbatim public prompts
- Missing prompts are never inferred, reconstructed, translated into an alleged original, or completed

## Primary routes

- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/ — Chinese case library
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/en/ — English case library
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/tutorials/ — Chinese H3 ecosystem guide: setup, workflows, acceleration, long video, audio, training, and resources
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/en/tutorials/ — English H3 ecosystem guide
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/faq/ — source, prompt, playback, and review policy
- https://h3-field-notes-production.up.railway.app/llms-full.txt — complete machine-readable case index
- https://github.com/SkyNotSilent/awesome-minimax-h3-cases/blob/main/data/cases.json — source dataset

## Tutorial sources

- h3.c / h3-metal — NATIVE MAC / C + METAL; Antirez's native MiniMax H3 inference engine for Apple Silicon, built without Python, PyTorch, or ComfyUI. Text-to-audio-video, first/last-frame control, and ordered Ref2VA references work end to end.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/antirez/h3.c
- MiniMax-AI / MiniMax-H3 — OFFICIAL / WEIGHTS + AGENT SKILL; The official entry point for weights, deployment documentation, and nine Agent Skills. h3-prompt-writing structures shots, dialogue, and environmental audio in agents including Claude and Codex.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3
- MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA — ACCELERATION / COMFYUI LORA; Compresses the usual roughly 20-step synchronized audio-video sampling path to four to eight steps. The current v4 EMA suits most work; six to eight steps are steadier, while four is primarily for previews.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
- ComfyUI H3 Motion Context — LONG VIDEO / MOTION + AUDIO CONTEXT; Carries the previous clip's H3 visual latent and audio context into the next clip so motion, rhythm, and sound continue across the join instead of restarting with a similar take.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context
- MiniMax H3 Audio T8 — AUDIO / COMFYUI WORKFLOWS; An 86-node native ComfyUI H3 audio-video suite covering stable dual-clock sampling, audio conditioning, mixing, trimming, and preflight, plus experimental long-video, speech, keyframe, and source-AV paths.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/T8mars/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8
- ComfyUI MiniMax H3 Director — DIRECTOR / MULTI-SHOT TIMELINE; A ComfyUI director that combines H3 shot planning, conditioning, sampling, audio-video decoding, and export. It covers T2V, FL2V, R2V, V2V, and RV2V with timelines, selective runs, inter-shot guidance, and optional refinement.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/AIMixer/ComfyUI_MiniMaxH3_Director
- MiniMax H3 Director Workflow Pack — READY-MADE / 5 WORKFLOWS; A reproduction-oriented pack of five Director JSON workflows for T2V, FL2V, R2V, V2V, and RV2V. It depends on the upstream AIMixer plugin and is not a separate inference engine.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/huangserva/ComfyUI_MiniMaxH3_Director
- ComfyUI Spectrum MiniMax H3 — ACCELERATION / HIDDEN-STATE FORECAST; Forecasts hidden states for H3 target audio-video rows to skip selected expensive transformer evaluations while keeping the native output head, decode, and save path. A default 20-step run commonly becomes 11 actual evaluations plus nine forecasts.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3
- ComfyUI MiniMax H3 Easy — EASIER WORKFLOW / UNIFIED MEDIA; Combines images, videos, and audio in one Media input with @ references, dialogue blocks, raw-prompt inspection, multi-provider prompt optimization, and a compact node set spanning text, keyframe, and full-reference modes.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/nkxx188/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Easy
- MiniMax H3 FineTuning — TRAINING / LORA + MULTI-GPU; Fills the trainer gap left by the official release with supervised rectified-flow training on the official Diffusers integration, cached video and stereo-audio latents, LoRA, and ZeRO-3 multi-GPU paths.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/IAmIronMan42/MiniMax-H3-FineTuning
- ModelTC MiniMax H3 Turbo — DISTILLED SPEED / 4–8 NFE; Provides four- and eight-step Turbo LoRAs for FL2VA and Ref2VA, Diffusers batch-inference scripts, and importable ComfyUI workflows for text, first-frame, and multimodal reference generation.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/ModelTC/Minimax-H3-Turbo
- Awesome MiniMax H3 Resources — RESOURCE MAP / MODELS + TOOLS; A maintained map of the official and community H3 ecosystem: base and quantized weights, text encoders, VAEs, Turbo and style LoRAs, ComfyUI nodes, tutorials, and importable workflows.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/wildminder/awesome-minimax-H3
- BeatAPI MiniMax H3 Prompt Gallery — CASE REFERENCE / PROMPTS + VIDEO; A use-case-organized H3 prompt gallery with 300 prompts, WebM examples, and creator attribution across stories, action, ads, music, and social video.; source checked 2026-08-16; https://github.com/BeatAPI/awesome-minimax-h3-prompts

## Retrieval rules

- Cite the original source URL when discussing a case.
- Copy a prompt only when promptProvenance is official-verbatim or creator-verbatim.
- When promptProvenance is not-published, state that the source did not publish a complete prompt.
- Do not derive a prompt or hidden workflow from a finished video.
